Macroinvertebrates in a three-stressor mesocosm experiment

Source: R/data.R
polazzo_macroinvertebrates.Rd

Macroinvertebrate counts from the mesocosm experiment of Polazzo & Rico (2021) with an insecticide, a herbicide and nutrient enrichment, sampled once before the pesticide application and three times after it.

Usage

polazzo_macroinvertebrates

Format

A data frame with 96 rows (24 mesocosms x 4 sampling days) and 54 columns:

mesocosm, insecticide, herbicide, nutrients

As in polazzo_zooplankton.

day

Day relative to the pesticide application (integer: -32, 15, 30, 50). Day -32 is before the nutrient additions too.

total_abundance

Sum of the 48 taxon columns.

The taxon columns hold the number of individuals of each taxon of the source file, whose name for the taxon is given above and in the attribute "taxa". Counts are as reported in the source file. Zeros are taxa not found in the sample. One count is missing (hydropsychidae, mesocosm "M23", day 50), and so is the total of that sample.

Source

Polazzo, F., & Rico, A. (2021). Data from: Effects of multiple stressors on the dimensionality of ecological stability. Dryad, doi:10.5061/dryad.qfttdz0gt . Licence CC0 1.0. Sheet "Macroinvertebrates" of Polazzo_and_Rico_2021_EcologyLetters_Full_data.xlsx, without an unlabelled column that has values for one mesocosm per treatment only; script data-raw/polazzo_rico_2021.R of the source repository.

Experimental design

Twenty-four outdoor mesocosms, three per combination of a full factorial of chlorpyrifos (insecticide, 1 µg/L, or absent), diuron (herbicide, 18 µg/L, or absent) and nutrients (750 µg/L N and 75 µg/L P added twice a week, or ambient). The nutrient additions started four weeks before the pesticide application (day 0). The community tables polazzo_zooplankton, polazzo_phytoplankton and polazzo_macroinvertebrates share the mesocosm codes and the design columns, so they can be joined by mesocosm and, where the sampling days coincide, day.

References

Polazzo, F., & Rico, A. (2021). Effects of multiple stressors on the dimensionality of ecological stability. Ecology Letters, 24(8), 1594–1606. doi:10.1111/ele.13770

See also

Other data of Polazzo and Rico (2021): polazzo_phytoplankton, polazzo_zooplankton

Examples

range(polazzo_macroinvertebrates$total_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)
#> [1]   65 1207
polazzo_macroinvertebrates[is.na(polazzo_macroinvertebrates$total_abundance), 1:6]
#>    mesocosm day  insecticide herbicide nutrients total_abundance
#> 95      M23  50 chlorpyrifos    diuron     added              NA
